newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Essex County, N.J..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
County of Essex,
New Jersey
County College Bonds
(County College Bond Act, P.L. 1971, c.12)
(Non-Callable) (Book-Entry Bonds) (Not Bank Qualified)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Acting County Treasurer of the County of Essex, New Jersey (the
County'') at the County of Essex, Hall of Records, 465 Dr.
Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard, Room 550, Newark, New
Jersey on
Tuesday, July 15, 1997,
until 11:00 a.m., for the purchase of the above Bonds of the
County dated July 15, 1997 and due on July 15 as follows:
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
The Bonds will be entitled to the benefits of P.L. 1971,
c. 12, of the Laws of New Jersey, as amended and
supplemented.
The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the
form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount
of each series of Bonds maturing in each year. The County
will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of
Lowenstein, Sandler, Kohl, Fisher & Boylan.
The Bonds will bear interest at a rate of interest in a
multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the
successful bidder payable on January 15, 1998, and
semiannually thereafter on the fifteenth day of January and
July in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to
the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in
accordance with the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to their
stated maturities.
The Bonds are subject to the requirements of SEC Rule
15c2-12 with respect to Secondary Market Disclosure.
The Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms
are available by contacting the Acting County Treasurer at
the County of Essex, Hall of Records, 465 Dr. Martin Luther
King Jr. Boulevard, Newark, New Jersey 07102, (201) 621-
/s/ LISAGOMEZ-RIVERA
Acting County Treasurer
(From The Bond Buyer)
